verdict.rationale: Wise offers two building blocks rather than a general rule engine. Spend-control rules automatically permit or block card transactions by merchant category code or currency [wise-docs-32]. Webhook subscriptions push events to your own endpoint, where you write the actions yourself [wise-docs-33, wise-docs-37]. Missing for 10: a native, user-configurable event→action automation or rule builder beyond card spend controls; documented trigger/action types (e.g. auto-transfer or auto-convert on incoming payment); hands-on or independent corroboration.
